text:
Artturi Lehkonen has become the Avalanche's most talked-about roster question by doing the thing that gets a player paid: scoring. He has 15 goals in 23 games, and Evan Rawal of the Denver Gazette noted after the win in Montreal that he's now on the top line and the top penalty-kill unit. Headlines this week ask whether Colorado can afford to keep him, or afford to lose him.

The goals sit on a real foundation and a lucky streak at the same time. He has generated 9.2 expected goals (the quality of his chances), and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 90th percentile for chances from the slot last season. But he's shooting 30%, against 14% last year, and the Avalanche have scored 11.8 more goals than expected with him on the ice. Evolving-Hockey also points out that his linemates rate in the 99th percentile, which flatters anyone's on-ice numbers. Our numbers project about 35 goals for the man who scored the Cup winner in 2022. Watch the shooting percentage, and the contract talk that will follow it.
headline: Artturi Lehkonen is scoring his way into a big decision
